messages:
From: Leila Hassan <finance@cloudspring.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier onboarding — invoice-only onboarding (no PO) for pilot

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for taking a look. We're starting a small pilot integration with Redwood next week and need onboarding completed before the first invoice. Our procurement currently cannot issue a PO for a vendor we don't yet have in the system.

Request: temporary invoice-only onboarding (no PO) for up to three invoices or $8,000, whichever comes first, for a 60-day pilot.

What CloudSpring can provide now:
- Completed vendor onboarding form (PDF)
- W-9 and company bank remittance stub
- Professional liability COI upon request

What we need from Redwood: list of required artifacts and any procurement approval path for a temporary exception. If there's a template/exception form we can fill, please forward. Target go-live: 2028-06-27.

Thanks,

Leila Hassan
Finance Manager | CloudSpring
finance@cloudspring.io
Attachments: cloudspring_vendor_form.pdf (application/pdf), w9-cloudspring.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Leila Hassan <finance@cloudspring.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding — invoice-only onboarding (no PO) for pilot

Leila —

Appreciate the quick detail and the attachments. We're happy to support a short, staged invoice-only path for a pilot but need a few items to satisfy procurement and finance controls. Below is what we typically require to approve a temporary no-PO exception. If you can return these within 48 hours we can fast-track the intake.

Required for a short-term (60-day) invoice-only exception:
1) Completed Redwood vendor intake form (we'll provide an editable PDF / DocuSign link)
2) Government tax form (W-9) — you indicated this is attached, thank you
3) Certificate of Insurance (COI) naming Redwood Inference as additional insured or waiver for the pilot window
4) Bank remittance plus a verification invoice from CloudSpring (first invoice must itemize pilot services)
5) Point of contact for billing disputes and an email to route invoices to (finance@redwoodinference.com)
6) Signed temporary exception request form (procurement sign-off required)

Operational constraints and controls we will apply if approved:
- Exception limited to 60 days or $10,000 cap, whichever first
- First invoice routed to finance@redwoodinference.com with subject line: "CloudSpring — Pilot Invoice (no PO)"
- Payments processed on standard terms once intake completes; exception does not change payment terms
- We reserve the right to require a PO mid-pilot if the spend trajectory increases

Next steps:
- I'll attach the procurement_temp_exception_form.pdf and an evidence checklist to this thread (cc'd procurement).
- Marissa / Karthik: can procurement confirm if the 60-day / $10k guardrails are acceptable, or propose alternate guardrails?

Leila, if you want the DocuSign link for the intake form I can send it now. Otherwise, send the COI and any additional documentation and we'll queue for procurement review.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Partner Onboarding Specialist | Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0124

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sat, 24 Jun 2028 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding — invoice-only onboarding (no PO) for pilot

Tessa / Karthik —

We can approve a staged exception for CloudSpring with the following mandatory conditions. This is a procurement-level temporary approval and must be tracked in our intake system.

Procurement decision (approved, conditional):
- Exception window: 60 days from onboarding completion
- Spend cap: $10,000 total during the window
- Allowed: up to 3 invoices; invoices must include line-item detail tying charges to the pilot scope
- Routing: invoices must be sent to finance@redwoodinference.com and cc procurement@redwoodinference.com for visibility
- Evidence required before final onboarding:
  • Completed Redwood vendor intake form (signed)
  • W-9 (done)
  • COI (min $1M general liability) — acceptable to receive within 48 hours, but must be on file before second invoice
  • Remittance verification and banking letter

I've attached the procurement_temp_exception_form.pdf and an evidence_matrix.xlsx which outlines acceptable items and evidence thresholds. Please upload both to the vendor intake ticket and link the HubSpot account (if one exists).

If CloudSpring meets these items by EOD Monday we will mark the vendor as "invoice-only allowed (pilot)" in the intake tracker. Karthik — if you'd prefer a shorter window or lower cap, propose edits and we'll finalize.

Marissa Cole
Head of Procurement | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: procurement_temp_exception_form.pdf (application/pdf), evidence_matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
